items.title: Report builder, snapshots, exports, configuration packages, and policy packs

items.title: Administrator privacy, security, audit, retention, and deletion lifecycle

items.title: Storage migration, backup, schema evolution, and operational recovery

items.title: Administrator sandbox, synthetic data, advanced analytics extensions, and phase boundary

Each slice refines the broad ledger items WI-0002..WI-0020. Storage and sign-in slices declare their dependency on Arca and Fides. Add a test that fails when a group that is not yet tested is not named by an open work item.

items.title: Signal 01: configurable data location and Signal-owned namespace through Arca (SIG-DATALOC-001, ADM-004 location/namespace, ADM-005, ADM-057)
items.description: Build order: Signal comes after Chrona and Summa (user decision 2026-10-08). Depends on arca slice 2 (data location, ARCA-LOC) and arca slice 3 (record format, ARCA-REC). New requirement SIG-DATALOC-001 (docs/requirements/SIGNAL-DATA-LOCATION.md): the data repository is configured per deployment, never hard-coded; Signal creates and owns its namespace and never assumes it is alone in the repository; its data must be separable under different permissions, which means its own repository, because GitHub permissions are per repository; no at-rest encryption for now (ADM-025's optional encryption stays deferred). Storage manifest and storage profiles. Refines ledger item WI-0012.

items.title: Signal 02: storage provider contract implemented on Arca's GitHub provider (ADM-003, ADM-004, ADM-006, ADM-025, ADM-026, ADM-044, ADM-046, ADM-058, ADM-073; AER-002, AER-003, AER-032)
items.description: Depends on WI-0038, arca slice 6 (GitHub adapter, ARCA-API/OUT), arca slice 7 (conformance suite, ARCA-TEST) and arca slice 8 (integrity, ARCA-INT). Signal's StorageProvider is Arca's interface; Signal owns only its domain mapping. Capability negative knowledge, untrusted-input loading, rate limits, growth warnings, protected-branch failure, and Aegis GitHub boundaries. Run Arca's conformance suite in Signal's CI. Refines WI-0012. Also closes the remaining parts of ADM-055 (see their gap-analysis rows).

items.title: Signal 03: administrator sign-in through Fides - credential lifecycle, browser secret policy, cross-tab coherence (ADM-056, ADM-071, ADM-072)

Memory-only by default, typed credential states, capability recomputation on permission change, and dataset identity checks on credential replacement. Refines WI-0011 and WI-0017.
